why_not_applied: Freeze before the first natural CHRON fire at 14:00. This is kernel runtime code (arifosmcp/runtime/identity.py). Changing a kernel status value hours before the first end-to-end observation risks confusing the very test the freeze protects. Recorded with full evidence so it applies cleanly afterwards.

finding.why_it_is_sharper_than_it_looks: The same dict carries BOTH values needed to compute a verdict. Line 79 puts canonical_commit beside line 80 running_commit. The function is HANDED running_commit as an argument for exactly this purpose. Then line 87 writes a bare constant. It has the measurement in hand and returns a label instead — the purest instance of declaration outranking mechanism found so far.
finding.callers_note: identity.py:4 documents that 'All identity surfaces (/identity, /health, Agent Card) derive from here', so this single literal seeds the whole /health family. The 6 VOID health surfaces are plausibly downstream of this one constant.

sketch: measured = None if running_commit in ('unknown', '', None) else (canonical == running_commit)
status = 'unknown' if measured is None else ('healthy' if measured else 'degraded')
drift = None if measured is None else (not measured)
rules_it_must_obey: Never default a reason. The kernel's own law, earned today: d['reason_code'] or 'DEPLOYMENT_DRIFT' can produce a drift label with no drift measured.
'unknown' is a legitimate third state — an unmeasured system is not a healthy one.
Do NOT let this module raise. Identity surfaces are load-bearing; a crash here breaks /health for everything.
proposed_change.acceptance_test: Call get_identity(running_commit=<canonical>) -> status healthy. Call get_identity(running_commit='deadbeef') -> status degraded AND drift true. Call get_identity() with no argument -> status unknown, never healthy.

verification_of_the_finding.method: read the source at the cited line, and confirm the sibling keys exist in the same returned dict

related_voids.note: 5 further /health surfaces report a bare constant with 0 live-state reads in their file. Each must be re-verified individually before renaming — two of this auditor's earlier finding sets were itself fabricated (14 invented endpoints, 40+ false orphans), so a count is not a finding.
